gate4.rationale: The support variant improved all three windows, but incremental positive PnL was too concentrated: max single positive share 0.6258 and HHI 0.4342 breached the Gate 4 concentration guard.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: risk allocation: accepted lagged consensus trades with cleaner signal-day cost/liquidity may deserve modest paper notional support.

2_history_check.exp-20260604-009: Accepted lagged consensus shared default-off adapter.
2_history_check.exp-20260604-010: Rejected lagged rank-priority scout versus accepted adapter.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md three fixed windows; before is the current accepted exp-20260604-009 lagged adapter. Accept only if all windows improve with survival, drawdown, concentration, and selectivity guards.

prediction.confidence_reason: Paper support fields have a positive history, but the accepted lagged consensus comparator is already strong and nearby retunes are risky.

preflight.alpha_hypothesis: Accepted lagged free-data consensus trades with cleaner signal-day execution quality may deserve modest paper notional support.
preflight.playbook_alignment: Meta research favors production-visible default-off paper adapters. This uses free OHLCV support fields and avoids changing the accepted source set, lagged prior window, cooldown, ranking, or live orders.
preflight.prior_difference: exp-20260604-009 promoted lagged source timing; exp-20260604-010 tested ranking priority and was rejected. This run leaves admission and ranking fixed, and tests only signal-day cost/liquidity support.

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A retained support result would need the shared free-data consensus adapter to compute the same signal-day cost/liquidity support in daily production and historical replay, with parity tests, before any report queue, paper ledger, or order surface could change.
